item.title: Nearly 70 million children now have a Trump Account, but parents must claim it
item.description: The Treasury auto-enrolled over 60 million children, with $4.5 billion added since July, but seed money goes only to certain kids.

item.title: Bezos says he understands socialism's rise, disputes politicians' housing blame
item.description: A record 43% of Americans view socialism favorably. The Amazon founder blames government policy for the housing crunch, citing Austin.

item.title: Vikrom Kromadit expands industrial park empire to Laos
item.description: Laos's green energy potential leads the Amata CEO to call the landlocked country the battery of Southeast Asia.
